failing.rule: Refund by days since delivery: from day 8 half
failing.example: Lakshmi's Rs 2,000 jacket returned on day 8 gets Rs 1,000

failing.rule: Clearance items follow the same day schedule
failing.example: clearance return on day 12 gets half (Rs 1,000 item -> Rs 500)

failing.rule: 1 loyalty point per full Rs 50 paid after discounts
failing.example: Rs 1,000 shirt sold at Rs 700 earns 14 points

failing.rule: Rs 100 minimum refund (under Rs 100 gets nothing)
failing.example: Rs 80 item returned on day 3 gets no refund

failing.rule: Amounts are rounded down to whole rupees
failing.example: Rs 333 item with 10% code refunds Rs 299
